notes.title: Bikini Hunter version 1.0.5 has been released.
Bikini Hunter version 1.0.4 has been released.
notes.content:
·Fixes

Corrected text.

Dodge roll speed has been increased.

Pressing the jump button while guarding will now backdash.

notes.title: Bikini Hunter version 1.0.3 has been released.
notes.content:
◆Modification details
・When you raise the level of a weapon, a window to advance the equipment will now appear.

-Fixed a bug in the English version UI.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Bikini Hunter version 1.0.2 has been released.
notes.content:
◆Modification details
-You can now select Y-axis reverse in the camera settings as an option.

・Text has been corrected.

- Reduced container durability.

Thank you for your continued support.

notes.title: Bikini Hunter version 1.0.1 has been released.
notes.content:
Version 1.0.1 has been released.

Fixes
Fixed a bug where bullets would not come out when moving the right stick.
Thank you.
